verdict.rationale: Pooler (B) is defensible for travelers who prioritize nearby evening dining options despite a short rideshare to the center. Airport North (C) is equally defensible for travelers who prioritize the lower rate, included breakfast, shuttle, and closest venue access, with the uncertain dinner handled separately if needed. The prompt supplies no preference that resolves this dining-versus-convenience tradeoff. A assumes an unestablished need for an on-site restaurant, and D gives up breakfast and incurs higher transport cost without a stated reason that its evening area is needed.
